segments.sn7.7:1.2: Atha kho suddhikabhāradvājo brāhmaṇo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi.
segments.sn7.7:1.3: Sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sāraṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
segments.sn7.7:1.4: Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho suddhikabhāradvājo brāhmaṇo bhagavato santike imaṃ gāthaṃ ajjhabhāsi –
segments.sn7.7:2.1: “Na brāhmaṇo [nābrāhmaṇo (?)] sujjhati koci, loke sīlavāpi tapokaraṃ;
segments.sn7.7:2.3: Vijjācaraṇasampanno, so sujjhati na aññā itarā pajā”ti.
segments.sn7.7:3.1: “Bahumpi palapaṃ jappaṃ, na jaccā hoti brāhmaṇo;
segments.sn7.7:4.5: Pappoti paramaṃ suddhiṃ, evaṃ jānāhi brāhmaṇā”ti.
segments.sn7.7:5.1: Evaṃ vutte, suddhikabhāradvājo brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn7.7:5.2: “abhikkantaṃ, bho gotama … pe … aññataro ca panāyasmā bhāradvājo arahataṃ ahosī”ti.

words: so sujjhati na aññā itarā pajā
lines: Sattame suddhikabhāradvājoti ayampi bhāradvājova, suddhikapañhassa pana pucchitattā saṅgītikārehi evaṃ vutto.
So sujjhati na aññā itarā pajāti so tevijjo brāhmaṇo sujjhati, ayaṃ pana aññā nāmikā pajā na sujjhatīti vadati.
Bahumpi palapaṃ jappanti bahumpi palapaṃ jappanto,“brāhmaṇova sujjhatī”ti evaṃ vacanasahassampi bhaṇantoti attho.
Vijjāti tayo vedāti vadanti “tāya idhalokatthaṃ paralokatthaṃ ñāyantī”ti katvā.
Tathā hi so eva tapaṃ ācarituṃ labhati, na itaro.
